title: IDSISA: Influence-Distilled Sharded Training for Efficient Machine Unlearning
abstract: arXiv:2611.06519v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Machine unlearning removes the influence of specific training examples to comply with privacy regulations. Full retraining gives strong guarantees but is computationally prohibitive at scale; approximate methods are efficient but lack formal guarantees. SISA (Sharded, Isolated, Sliced, and Aggregated training) achieves certified deletion through data sharding and independent retraining, but random partitioning scatters forget requests across most shards, and isolated retraining degrades utility. We introduce IDSISA (Influence-Distilled SISA), which uses influence functions to concentrate forget-prone samples into few shards and distillation from unaffected shards to recover utility lost to isolation. translated_title: IDSISA：面向高效机器遗忘的影响蒸馏分片训练方法
translated_abstract: 机器遗忘旨在移除特定训练样本对模型的影响，以符合隐私法规。完全重训能提供强保证，但在大规模场景下计算代价过高；近似方法虽然高效，却缺乏形式化保证。SISA（分片、隔离、切片与聚合训练）通过数据分片和独立重训实现了可认证的删除，但随机划分会将遗忘请求分散到大多数分片中，且隔离重训会降低模型效用。我们提出IDSISA（影响蒸馏SISA），利用影响函数将易被遗忘的样本集中到少数分片中，并通过来自未受影响分片的蒸馏来恢复因隔离训练而损失的效用。从SISA重训步骤继承的删除保证依然精确，无需任何概率性限定；而基于蒸馏的效用恢复则是一个单独量化、经验上有界的近似（ε...（摘要原文在此处截断）
